Return all approved drug indications. For each indication, provide the drug ChEMBL ID, drug preferred name, MeSH ID, MeSH heading, EFO ID, EFO label, and max phase for indication. Filter for drugs where max_phase_for_ind equals 4. Source data from molecule_dictionary joined with drug_indication. Sort by drug ChEMBL ID, drug preferred name, MeSH ID, MeSH heading, EFO ID, EFO label, and max phase for indication.
